Uber announces 10% workforce reduction globally

Uber is implementing a significant workforce reduction, laying off approximately 10% of its global staff. This move aims to streamline operations, making the company "simpler and faster." The layoffs are the largest since 2020 and are intended to cut management layers. CEO Dara Khosrowshahi communicated the decision to employees.
